For each predictor, the category with the lowest warm-season HRI ED visit rate was identified as the referent population.

notes: Rates are visits per 100,000 ED visits (a proportion of visits) but are modelled as Poisson counts with an offset, so count/rate is used. The 95th-percentile exceedance is a cutpoint (quantization), not a procedure; it serves as a fixed referent for 2023 daily rates. Comparisons of 2023 vs 2018–2022 RRs rest on separate models with no formal test of difference.
view_issues: Methods say a maximum of 826 facilities (median 36) while footnotes and table notes say 823 (median 111). 'Multivariate' Poisson means multivariable. Text says region RRs in 2023 were '1.5–2.5 times those during 2018–2022', a ratio of RRs not shown in Table 1.
